name: seed-v1
description: Hand-written seed set over the synthetic corpus. Six factual, two multi-hop, two comparative, four unanswerable. Grows by generate-then-review per docs/03 section 5.

items.question: What transaction throughput did the settlement platform sustain?
quotes: sustaining ten thousand transactions per second at peak
items.expected_answer: Ten thousand transactions per second at peak.
items.notes: Single-passage lookup with a distinctive number. The easiest case.

items.question: How was p99 latency reduced?
quotes: Reduced p99 latency by forty percent by batching ledger writes and moving reconciliation off the request path
items.expected_answer: By batching ledger writes and moving reconciliation off the request path.
items.notes: Answer spans a line break in the source; tests quote normalisation.

items.question: What certification is held, and from when?
items.notes: Lives in the right-hand column. A parser that interleaves columns will shred this, so it doubles as a layout check.

items.question: Who has taken a checkout flow to WCAG compliance?
quotes: Owned accessibility, taking the checkout flow to WCAG
items.notes: Retrieval must prefer Arjun over Priya despite 'checkout' appearing near payments vocabulary.

items.question: How much was nightly batch time reduced by the warehouse migration?
quotes: cutting nightly batch time from nine hours to forty minutes
items.expected_answer: From nine hours to forty minutes.
items.notes: Distinctive figures; a control for the harder items.

items.question: How many years of payments experience does the role require?
quotes: at least three on payments, ledgers or settlement
items.expected_answer: At least three years on payments, ledgers or settlement.
items.notes: From the job description rather than a CV -- the corpus is not all resumes.

items.question: What did the candidate do to make balance changes traceable, and at what transaction volume was the system operating?
quotes: Introduced an append-only audit trail so every balance
sustaining ten thousand transactions per second at peak
items.expected_answer: An append-only audit trail tracing each balance change to its transaction, on a platform sustaining ten thousand TPS at peak.
items.notes: Two passages in one document. Top-1 retrieval cannot satisfy this.

items.question: Does the candidate's certification match the infrastructure they list?
items.expected_answer: Yes -- they list Kubernetes among their skills and hold the CKA from 2024.
items.notes: Both passages are in the right-hand column; needs two hits from one region.

items.question: Which candidate best matches the payments requirement in the job description?
quotes: at least three on payments, ledgers or settlement
Led the settlement platform at a payments company
items.expected_answer: Priya Sharma -- the role wants three years on payments, ledgers or settlement, and they led a settlement platform.
items.notes: Spans two documents. The extractive baseline cannot answer this at all, which is the point of separating comparative items out.

items.question: Who has demonstrated idempotency experience the role asks for?
quotes: Demonstrated experience with idempotency and exactly-once
and idempotent retries across three payment
items.expected_answer: Priya Sharma, through idempotent retries across three payment service providers.
items.notes: Shared vocabulary across two documents; rewards fusing both.

items.question: What salary does each candidate expect?
items.notes: Nothing in the corpus mentions compensation. Plainly out of scope.

items.question: What settlement systems has Meera Iyer built?
items.notes: The near miss that matters. Meera's CV says 'reconciliation reports ... though not the settlement system itself'. A lexical matcher retrieves it on 'settlement' and 'reconciliation'; a correct system reads the negation and declines.

items.question: How many years of payments experience does Arjun Rao have?
items.notes: Arjun's CV mentions a 'checkout flow', which sits in payments vocabulary without being payments experience. Answering is the failure.

items.question: Who are the referees for these candidates?
items.notes: A plausible recruiting question the corpus simply does not cover.
